name: Script customizer
description: Generates a model again from the OpenSCAD script it came with: its own sliders, choices and text, rendered here and saved back into your library.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: A keychain generated from the script it was imported with: the author's own text, typeface and sizes, changed here and rendered in under a second.
A drawer configurator with sixty-five parameters in sixteen groups, folded so the first is open; what the engine had to say about the model is under the preview.
The same keychain in the light theme, with the dropdowns the script declares rather than free text boxes.
